mode: Read-only source inspection; no remote or GitHub Actions execution

candidate.contract: Every shard carries expected_rows; validate_shard checks exact fields and selected source identities. export_env validates then emits only established harness knobs.

production_consumers.legacy_mode: Changes artifact reuse versus local Cargo, not planner/shard/summary source checkout.

production_consumers.explicit_head_assertions: plan and shard; summary has no duplicate HEAD assertion
production_consumers.limitation: Summary relies on the pinned checkout action's default event-revision contract. No different ref is configured; runtime checkout identity was not independently observed.

closure_facts: All three workflows pass the complete plan output through fromJSON and toJSON; none reconstructs the old five-field shard object.
Summary reads the same plan job's full JSON. No persisted old plan or external plan producer was found in executable callers.
prebuilt.py imports validate_shard from sibling matrix.py at line 15; select validates at line 42; plan delegates to select at lines 53-64. Its unchanged file hash does not freeze an old validator.
node-boot-build.yml uses inputs.revision and checks HEAD at lines 52-61. Calling workflows pass the same candidate revision used by planning and execution.
Prebuilt bundles contain manifest and binaries, not copies of matrix.py. prebuilt.py lines 92-102 and 173-183 bind and verify checkout identity and variant.

Other prebuilt callers use build, verify, or unpack rather than JSON shard selection: node_boot/run.sh, game_platform/lifecycle.sh, wp5_s3b/run.sh, world_compiler_artifact.py, world_bundle_artifact_boot.rs, integration-shards-dispatch.yml, and additional merge-group/build workflow jobs.

External direct matrix.shard use is confined to test_matrix.py and is updated in the candidate patch. Other Python shard consumers derive objects from matrix.plan. Repository policy checks inspect workflow strings rather than deserialize shard objects.

test_consumer_issue_at_review.fact: run_aggregate obtains matrix.plan('pr') but emits one synthetic {shard}-s scenario per World shard.
test_consumer_issue_at_review.inference: The new required-row coverage check rejects this positive fixture because it omits the planned expected_rows identities.
test_consumer_issue_at_review.verification: Identified by source inspection; root is preparing the fixture correction and negative missing-ID control. This artifact does not claim that correction was reviewed or executed.

fixture_follow_up.result: Correction independently reviewed. Both unchanged real workflow aggregate scripts pass the complete fixture and reject removal of exactly C03.full from a nonempty 4-to-3 scenario shard. Exit codes and NODE_BOOT_PASS evidence remain successful. The baseline aggregate accepts both fixtures after stripping only the unknown expected_rows plan field.
fixture_follow_up.scope: Read-only repository review plus local subprocess replay. No repository edits, remote calls, or live Game/GitHub qualification execution.

conclusion: Static caller closure found no production path mixing a new plan with an old matrix consumer or a configured different source revision. The existing aggregate-test fixture incompatibility was corrected and independently verified by the follow-up replay.
limitations: No workflow execution or external checkout-action source verification performed for this read-only review.
